title: Petra and the Extraction
author: Sebastian Eriksen
blurb: Vesper Sandoval, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
